description: Add an item to your LogPulse roadmap, or update one by id — move it to in progress or shipped, change its ETA, or link the release that shipped it. Needs a LogPulse API key with the “Update roadmap” permission, sent as the Authorization header.

description.description: What and why, in a sentence or two.

eta.description: Free text, e.g. Q3 or July.

id.description: Update this item instead of creating a new one.

is_public.description: Show on the public roadmap. Defaults to true for new items.

label.description: Short tag, e.g. API or Mobile.

linked_release.description: Release id, version or slug that shipped this item.

status.description: Roadmap column. New items default to planned.

name: post_roadmap_update
title: Post roadmap update
